SAF-03 mandates an audit trail for accountability. SAF-04 focuses on error handling to recover from faults, and SAF-05 guarantees continued access during outages. SAF-06 and SAF-07 ensure accurate currency conversions and regular backups, respectively, reinforcing overall system safety and reliability.

transcript.statement: Responsibility is crucial in a bookkeeping system to ensure ethical standards and compliance with regulations. requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards for legal accountability.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their roles.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 7 years.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall process all financial transactions within 2.5 seconds while ensuring compliance checks are prioritized.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by integrating energy-efficient algorithms.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
The system shall support multi-currency transactions with transparent exchange rates.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity.
The system shall ensure accurate currency conversions to prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
